initial_plan.can_answer_question: partly: the file has no distance-travelled or exposure measure, so it cannot estimate deaths per mile; it can show motorist deaths per police-reported crash
initial_plan.metric: annual number_of_motorist_killed divided by the number of police-reported crash rows
initial_plan.denominator: all police-reported crash rows with crash_date in the same calendar year
initial_plan.population: police-reported NYC crashes with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025; recorded motorist deaths on those rows form the numerator
initial_plan.aggregation: sum recorded motorist deaths divided by crash-row count within each year

data_check.rows: 2,132,218 crash rows in 2013–2025; annual row counts are in check_2.csv
data_check.missing_or_invalid: Among rows in the selected years, crash_date is missing/default/invalid in 0 rows and number_of_motorist_killed is missing in 0 rows.
data_check.coverage: All years 2013–2025 have records from January 1 through December 31; no partial year was found.
data_check.implication_and_decision: No selected rows need to be excluded or handled as a separate group for missing dates or motorist-death values. Use all dated crash rows as the denominator and all recorded motorist deaths as the numerator. This crash-normalized measure is not an exposure-adjusted per-mile risk measure.

final_plan.can_answer_question: partly: the data cannot answer whether deaths per mile declined because it contains no miles-driven denominator; it can describe recorded motorist deaths per police-reported crash
final_plan.metric: annual sum of number_of_motorist_killed divided by the annual count of police-reported crash rows
final_plan.denominator: all police-reported NYC crash rows dated in the same calendar year
final_plan.population: all police-reported NYC crash rows dated within each full calendar year 2013–2025; recorded motorist deaths on those crashes form the numerator
final_plan.years: 2013–2025 inclusive; each year has records for all dates from January 1 to December 31
final_plan.aggregation: sum number_of_motorist_killed divided by count of crash rows in the year
final_plan.limitations: No miles-driven exposure is present, so deaths per crash cannot establish per-mile risk. The data contains police-reported crashes only. No selected crash date or motorist-death value is missing, and no year is partial; all selected crash rows are retained.
